an4.32:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these four means of sustaining a favorable relationship.
an4.32:1.3: Giving, endearing speech, beneficent conduct, and impartiality.
an4.32:1.4: These are the four means of sustaining a favorable relationship.”
an4.32:2.4: as is suitable to fit each case: these means
an4.32:2.6: are like the linchpin of a rolling chariot.
an4.32:3.1:
If there were no such means
of sustaining a favorable relationship,
an4.32:3.3: would be able to obtain esteem
an4.32:4.1:
But since there exist these means
of sustaining a favorable relationship,
